ticket_two.title: Alert when an outbound transaction stays PENDING longer than 15 minutes
ticket_two.why: The customer noticed after 47 minutes. A threshold alert carrying the channel's last note would have opened this ticket 30 minutes earlier, or removed the need for the customer to open it.
